sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, welcome Alsager Town to the Deva Stadium on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders are in excellent form, having won their last match and recording five wins in their last six outings (W-D-W-W-W). Alsager Town arrive in 19th place with just 4 points and are struggling badly, having lost their last four games in a row, making this a favorable fixture for the in-form Sandbach side.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town at 15:00, with Stafford looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in what should be a competitive clash between two sides in the upper reaches of the division. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a local derby; both sides sit in the top half and will be keen to secure three points. In the chasing pack, Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton visit Shawbury United—the latter are in dire form with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, with both clubs in the lower-mid table seeking to climb the standings. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling in 17th, travel to face Telford Town (18th) in a fixture between two of the division's poorest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both sides looking to move away from the relegation zone. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, who sit bottom of the league with just 2 points from seven games.
